map.输入营业收入与营业成本，求毛利。: Compute gross profit and gross margin from revenue and cost of goods sold.
map.毛利 = 营业收入 − 营业成本: Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Sales
map.毛利 = 营收 − 营业成本: Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Sales
map.毛利为营收减直接成本。: Gross profit is revenue minus direct cost.
map.核算单期产品盈利的绝对额，作为费用与税费抵扣前的基数。: Computes the absolute amount of single-period product profit as the base before deducting expenses and taxes.
map.对比不同业务板块毛利贡献，优化产品与资源分配。: Compare the gross profit contribution of different business segments to optimise product and resource allocation.
map.制定目标毛利，反推可接受的最高采购/生产成本。: Set a target gross profit and work back to the maximum acceptable purchase/production cost.
map.某公司营业收入 1000 万元、营业成本 700 万元，毛利=1000−700=: A company has revenue of 1000 (10k CNY) and cost of sales of 700 (10k CNY), so gross profit = 1000−700 = 300 (10k CNY) - the preliminary profit after deducting direct cost.
map.毛利和营业利润的区别？: What is the difference between gross profit and operating profit?
map.毛利=收入−营业成本；营业利润还需扣除税金及附加、销售/管理/研发费用与资产减值: Gross profit = revenue − cost of sales; operating profit additionally deducts taxes and surcharges, selling/administrative/R&D expenses and asset impairments, so it is closer to the final profit from day-to-day operations.
map.如何提高毛利？: How can gross profit be increased?
map.要么提升售价（品牌/差异化），要么降低营业成本（供应链优化、规模采购、工艺改进）: Either raise the selling price (branding/differentiation) or reduce cost of sales (supply-chain optimisation, bulk purchasing, process improvement), while guarding against margin erosion from trading price for volume.
